title: DPCA Canceller
source_docs: Phased Array System Toolbox/Space-Time Adaptive Processing/DPCA_Canceller.md
text: Displaced phase center array (DPCA) pulse canceller for a uniform linear array, 5 inputs, 2 outputs, {Array axis} sets Linear axis direction of ULA; {Signal propagation speed (m/s)} sets the signal propagation speed physconst, {Operating frequency (Hz)} sets the system operating frequency 3e8, {Specify PRF as} sets the source of PRF, {Pulse repetition frequency (Hz)}, {Specify direction as} sets the source of targeting, {Receiving mainlobe direction (deg)} sets the pointing direction of main lobe of array, {Number of bits in phase shifters} sets the number of phase shift quantization bits, {Specify targeting Doppler as} sets the source of targeting, {Targeting Doppler (Hz)} sets the targeting Doppler of STAP processor, {Enable weights output} sets the option to output beamformer weights, {Output pre-Doppler result} sets the output results before Doppler filtering, {Simulate using} sets the block simulation method Interpreted, {Specify sensor array as} sets the method to specify array Array, {Expression} sets the mATLAB expression used to create an array Phased Array System Toolbox™ array System, {Element type} sets the array element types, {Operating frequency range (Hz)} sets the operating frequency range of the antenna or microphone element, {Operating frequency vector (Hz)} sets the operating frequency range of custom antenna or microphone elements, {Baffle the back of the element} sets the back response of an Isotropic Antenna element or an Omni Microphone element, {Exponent of cosine pattern} sets the exponents of azimuth and elevation cosine patterns, {Frequency responses (dB)} sets the antenna and microphone frequency response, {Input Pattern Coordinate System} sets the coordinate system of custom antenna pattern, {Azimuth angles (deg)} sets the azimuth angles of antenna radiation pattern, {Elevation angles (deg)} sets the elevation angles of antenna radiation pattern, {Phi Angles (deg)} sets the phi angle coordinates of custom antenna radiation pattern, {Theta Angles (deg)} sets the theta angle coordinates of custom antenna radiation pattern, {Magnitude pattern (dB)} sets the magnitude of combined antenna radiation pattern, {Phase pattern (deg)} sets the custom antenna radiation phase pattern, {MatchArrayNormal} sets the rotate antenna element to array normal, {Polar pattern frequencies (Hz)} sets the polar pattern microphone response frequencies, {Polar pattern angles (deg)} sets the polar pattern response angles, {Polar pattern (dB)} sets the custom microphone polar response zeros, {Number of elements} sets the number of array elements in U, {Element spacing} sets the distance between ULA elements and {Taper} sets the uLA array taper. Values come from the instance.
